vibe.rationale: Downgrade from July 7 evening Vibe 4. Acute overnight military exchange — tanker attacks plus CENTCOM retaliatory strikes plus Iran's 80+ US facility counterstrikes — is the most geographically extensive Iranian counter-strike of the post-MOU period. Trump 'agreement is over' language is the most extreme MOU-status presidential statement since June 19. Treasury oil sanctions waiver revocation strips a core MOU-negotiated concession. Two concurrent Washington state wildfire crises (Chelan Hills 0%, Sourdough 0%) with national aerial resource competition at PL4 Day 10 and AR window closing tonight. FOMC at 9-9 split with September hike still 66% priced. Stabilizers: no formal MOU termination instrument issued; Doha working groups nominally active; Navarre Coulee confirmed small (300 acres, 80% contained); AR window still open for fire suppression today. Upgrade path to 4: Trump walks back 'over' language or Doha meeting announced + any Chelan Hills initial containment + FOMC minutes signal dovish lean. Downgrade path to 2: Iran formally voids MOU citing US strikes + CENTCOM resumes Project Freedom-scale operations + Sourdough/Chelan Hills merger event.

analyst_summary: The Strait of Hormuz overnight exchange is the morning's defining event. Three tankers struck, CENTCOM retaliatory strikes executed, Iran's most geographically extensive counter-strike of the post-MOU period executed against 80+ US facilities. Trump 'I think the agreement is over' is the sharpest presidential language since the June 19 MOU signing. Treasury's revocation of Iran's oil sanctions waiver is not rhetoric — it strips the MOU's central economic incentive for Iranian participation. The working assumption entering this morning is that the MOU is under severe acute stress without formal termination. The Doha Working Groups are nominally Day 5 but effectively superseded by overnight events. At 2 PM ET the FOMC minutes land — the only on-record signal from a 9-9 split committee where the chair withheld his own dot. Markets are pricing 66% September hike odds into a June NFP miss environment. The PNW fire picture is unchanged from overnight: two fires at 0% containment, atmospheric river window active through tonight for Chelan Hills and closing tonight for Sourdough. Navarre Coulee is confirmed small and not a compounding threat. The day's outcome on Vibe 3 depends heavily on whether Trump or the Iranian side issues any moderating statement on MOU status, and whether afternoon FOMC minutes signal any dovish accommodation.
